title: Tropical Storm Edouard, September 2026

event.title: Tropical Storm Edouard, September 2026
event.purpose: Second storm selected by the researcher; evaluate all available, aligned windows ending during September 1–3 UTC. No scores are assumed.
event.focus_selection: Common initialization and ending time for 6/12/24h where available; select the available 24h window with greatest MRMS fraction above 50.8 mm, then maximum and stable record id. Diagnostic selection uses observations.

comparison_design: Operational ANN-CSGD 0.25° and frozen full-history GNN-CSGD 0.25°, using the same forecast windows, HRRR predictors, regional MRMS targets and verification points. Raw HRRR is the deterministic baseline.
scope: All 32 previously verified Edouard windows. ANN and GNN use duration-specific historical training archives and 2024 validation; model architectures and original training objectives differ. GNN is retrospective inference from frozen weights. Other ANN predictor resolutions are not available for this event. Between-storm scores refer to different regions and weather and are not a controlled skill ranking.

models.label: GNN-CSGD 0.25° (full history)
models.training_design: GNN full_v1: 2020–2023, 6,556 training records; 2024 validation, 1,825 records. Frozen original training objective; no storm fitting.
models.forecast_mode: Retrospective frozen-checkpoint inference using forecast-only inputs on the complete CONUS graph, then exact regional node selection. No claim of original issue-time availability.

focus_selection: Common initialization and ending time for 6/12/24h where available; select the available 24h window with greatest MRMS fraction above 50.8 mm, then maximum and stable record id. Diagnostic selection uses observations.

method.crps: Correct analytic CSGD CRPS including shift times the squared probability mass at zero; float64; units mm
method.scoring_revision: All frozen ANN and GNN distributions scored with the corrected zero-mass formula. Earlier case CRPS values omitted this term and are superseded. Probabilities and Brier definitions are unchanged. The supplied training implementations also omit this term; these frozen checkpoints are evaluated without retraining. This page does not claim they were optimized using the corrected CRPS objective.
method.brier_baseline: Raw deterministic HRRR converted to 0/1 exceedance; no case climatology BSS
method.reliability: 10 equally spaced probability bins; empty bins omitted from curves, counts retained
method.uncertainty: No inferential intervals or significance claims for a single selected storm
method.spatial_support: Common points. No area-averaging, flood-probability verification, or new native-target comparison.
method.temporal_support: Each accumulation window scored separately. Overlapping windows must not be summed or treated as independent.

map_update.contour_missing_rule: Only fully populated 0.25-degree quadrilaterals; no extrapolation
map_update.observed_outline: Exterior tile edges around sampled MRMS exceedance locations; not a high-resolution storm boundary
map_update.source: Original event-export arrays; no inference rerun
map_update.geography: US Census Bureau TIGERweb; geographic context retrieved 2026-09-13
map_update.support: Common 0.25-degree point samples. Shading is a display representation, not additional observations or area-averaged rainfall.
map_update.interpretation: CSGD means describe predictive expectations; exceedance probabilities are checked against binary MRMS events.
